text:
tess: Quick sync — we're doing a blue/green split for the API/runtime/console/router change in the 01:00-03:00 quiet window. Pins: runtime 2.5.0-alpha, console 3.2.1, router-shim 1.9. Plan: 10% every 3m for first 30m, then 50% hold for 10m, then promote.

deploy-bot: preflight ok: pins applied, db migration check skipped (no schema change), auth contract validated.

kevin: noted. I'll watch runtime GPU latency and OOMs. Add circuit-breaker: if runtime 99th > 240ms for 4m OR OOMs >1 in a host -> rollback.

rachel: Console: watch header-split logs and UI telemetry; if user-facing errors creep above 0.4% in any region -> rollback.

sam: Router: route table diff minimal. I want a soft-fallback route ready: `route set weight blue=100 green=0` quick cmd.

tess: Agree. Also enable sampling: traces=100% for green during first 20m. Cost team ok with sampling.

deploy-bot: starting split: step 1 -> 10% green

kevin: runtime p95 bumped +10% but p99 is 198ms. No OOMs.

rachel: console shows a handful of parsing warnings in EU, not user-impacting. Toggling diagnostics.

sam: router queues normal. No connection resets.

deploy-bot: step 2 -> 20% green

kevin: GPU util up, but headroom ok. Adding temporary autoscale threshold to prevent cold-starts.

rachel: UX telemetry still clean.

tess: hold after 30m? we planned 50% hold for 10m then promote.

deploy-bot: step 3 -> 30% green

kevin: p99 reads 210ms for runtime in ap-south, but stabilized in 2m. Keep an eye.

rachel: EU warnings spiked then resolved after diag toggle. No errors to users.

sam: pushing a router fallback script to on-call repo in case we need immediate rollback.

kevin: adding rollback shorthand for runtime: `deploy-bot rollback runtime` — will route back to blue and unpin green.

rachel: console rollback snippet: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console -n prod` and notify deploy-bot to unlock.

sam: router rollback: `routerctl set-weight green 0 && routerctl flush`

deploy-bot: armed automated hooks: runtime p99 >240ms for 4m -> auto-rollback (requires 2 approvers for cross-service).

tess: We're at 50% hold now. Monitoring window started. If anyone sees persistent regression shout "hold-and-rollback".

kevin: runtime spike cleared, p99 back to 205ms. No OOMs.

rachel: console stable. Shipping small release note: "runtime 2.5.0-alpha: improved batching; console 3.2.1: header split telemetry; router 1.9: fallback shim."

sam: router OK. Prepared a short troubleshooting checklist in the handoff doc.

deploy-bot: hold expired. Decision: promote to 100%. Executing sawtooth promote.

tess: Promote approved.

kevin: Monitoring for next 30m, no active alerts.

rachel: Posting follow-ups: CR-501 (console header diagnostics) and CR-502 (trace sampling dashboard).

sam: I'll craft a router perf ticket for shedding improvements.

deploy-bot: cut complete. Pins recorded: runtime=2.5.0-alpha, console=3.2.1, router=1.9. Release notes: https://redwood/relnotes/2777777771

tess: Great work. Locking thread and saving logs. If anyone spots regressions, reopen thread with "hold-and-rollback" mention. :lock:
